title: Bluegate Moving Truck Rental Reservation Changes and Rental Extensions
content:
**Reservations desk guidance — changing a Bluegate Moving Truck Rental reservation or extending a rental.**

- A reservation in reserved status may be changed to another vehicle class or other times at no charge.
- A rental in picked-up status may be extended only where the class allows extensions and the request is made at least the class extension lead (elapsed hours) before the scheduled return time, and the contract may not run beyond the class maximum number of rental periods in total.
- Changes are made only to contracts in reserved or picked-up status, as the contract's status stands in the company's records.
- Moving a free move-in reservation to a class that is not eligible for the free move-in truck removes the benefit.

## Status and the change allowed

| Contract status | Change allowed |
|---|---|
| Reserved | Another vehicle class or other times, at no charge |
| Picked up | An extension, within the class extension lead and the class maximum number of rental periods |
| Returned, closed, cancelled or no-show | None |

## Extension lead (hypothetical rental of a Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck, extension lead 2 hours, scheduled return 18:00)

| Extension requested at | At least 2 hours before 18:00 |
|---|---|
| 15:30 | Yes |
| 16:00 | Yes — exactly 2 hours before is at least 2 hours |
| 16:01 | No |

On a Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck, whose extension lead is 4 hours, the same 18:00 return could be extended on a request made at 14:00 but not on one made at 14:01. On every class the maximum is 3 rental periods per contract, so a contract already running 3 rental periods is not extended further.

## Free move-in reservations

A free move-in reservation on a Bluegate Cargo Van moved to a Bluegate 15 ft Moving Truck keeps the benefit (both classes are eligible); the same reservation moved to a Bluegate 20 ft Moving Truck loses it.
